items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: Harry James followed Red, I forgot now. Harry James took off and left Red there, because Red was always too good.

ctx.x: Red made a lot of fads at the right time, but at the same period I was leaving Red, Glenn Miller had just begun (inaudible), so he walked off with it that year.
I think it was a year later I went to the Ben Franklin in Philadelphia with Red and he followed Harry James or
Harry James followed Red, I forgot now. Harry James took off and left Red there, because Red was always too good. That was always his problem, he liked music.
